name: device-discovery
description: Discover network devices using extensible protocol-specific discoverers.

Device Discovery: Export Results to CSV

deviceDiscovery.scanDuration.description: How long to listen for discovery responses, in seconds. Set 0 to scan continuously until cancelled. Positive whole numbers have no configured upper limit. Applies to all discoverers. Results appear as they arrive.

deviceDiscovery.defaultAdapter.description: Name of the default network adapter (for example, en0 on macOS). The current IPv4 address is resolved each scan. Leave empty to choose when scanning. Use Device Discovery: Select Adapter to pick an adapter and optionally save it. If the adapter is unavailable, you will be asked to select another.

deviceDiscovery.discoverers.crestron.ena.description: Include the Crestron discoverer in Scan for All Devices. The Scan for Crestron Devices command remains available when unchecked.

deviceDiscovery.discoverers.mdns.enabled.description: Include mDNS service discovery in Scan for All Devices. The Scan for mDNS Devices command remains available when unchecked.

deviceDiscovery.mdns.serviceTypes.description: Only show these mDNS service types in mDNS and Scan for All results. Empty shows all discovered services. Use short names such as _http and _ssh (any transport), or full types such as _http._tcp.local (specific transport). Changes apply to the next scan.

deviceDiscovery.discoverers.globalCache..description: Include Global Caché in Scan for All Devices. Direct scans remain available when unchecked. Global Caché and AMX Discovery share a single beacon listener and produce separate results.

deviceDiscovery.discoverers.amx.enabled.description: Include AMX-compatible devices from other manufacturers in Scan for All Devices. Direct scans remain available when unchecked. Global Caché and AMX Discovery share a single beacon listener and produce separate results.
